summary.headline: Planets as Lords of the Ascendant
summary.text: Interpretation of the lord of the ascendant: Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, and Mercury signify contrasting bodily qualities, character traits, social rank, talents, and vices according to whether they are well placed and free from evil or impeded in a bad place.
